_doc: clinic-responsive — the product must be usable on the width most people actually browse at.
Asserted, not eyeballed: no horizontal overflow and no element hanging off the right edge at
390 x 844 (iPhone-class) or at 1280 desktop, on both the front door and the booking page.
The confirm dock is the one that matters — if it overflows, the one act a person can perform
is the thing that falls off the screen.

eval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-armed] button, [data-clinic-action="open-slot"]'); if (!b) return 'missing'; const r = b.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width >= 44 && r.height >= 24 ? 'ok' : `${Math.round(r.width)}x${Math.round(r.height)}`; })()
